responsibility: Provides the scheduler model for Cortex-A57, including scalar issue pipelines, load/store behavior, FP/NEON classification, and crypto execution timing. It defines a Cortex-A57-specific NEON type attribute, issue and execution reservations for integer, SIMD, floating-point, load/store, branch, and crypto instructions, along with bypasses and blocking behavior, to drive tuning and instruction scheduling for cortexa57 and related reusers of this model.
